highlights: The three simulator readings that 0.7.2 listed as a little off now agree with ngspice or the exact answer, and two rarer circuits that went wrong now run right.
While the scope works it says what it is doing: how many periods it has let the circuit settle, then how much of the record it has acquired.
A capture after Autoset no longer settles the circuit a second time, and an AC-coupled channel no longer waits out its coupling capacitor's charge.
Keys for the scope: 1 and 2 pick a channel, the arrows turn its VOLTS/DIV and TIME/DIV, Shift with the arrows moves its trace.
In the calculator, Backspace after a bracket removes the pair and keeps what was inside, and the side panel's heading reads GIVEN.
